## Put AI to **Work** For Your Privacy Team

Your privacy team deserves AI that actually does the work, not just the talking. Vera has the context, automation, and human control to tackle privacy jobs.

### Turn cookie chaos into AI control

Replace regulatory stress with always-on AI control.

Vera will proactively detect and investigate new cookies, suggest rules, and apply them when you give the word.

[Learn more](https://www.datagrail.io/platform/consent-management/)

### Autofill evidence-based assessments in minutes.

No more inaccurate, incomplete, and irrelevant assessments.

Vera employs global privacy context to create evidence-based PIAs, DPIAs, AI risk assessments, and TIAs fast.

[Learn more](https://www.datagrail.io/platform/risk-assessments/)

### Find and fix risks that matter

Stop privacy issues before they impact your business.

Vera flags risks across 22,000+ applications, and creates personalized action plans to accelerate resolution.

[Learn more](https://www.datagrail.io/platform/risk-register/)

### Generate insights and reports on demand

Need a privacy ROI report? Trying to understand how a new regulation will impact you? Evaluating a new system and feeling stuck?

Vera is ready to help 24/7.

[Learn more](https://www.datagrail.io/platform/)
